description: List KPIs (scorecard measurables) on the org chart, filterable by owner, each with its goal and its latest recorded value, the period that value is for, and whether it meets the goal. Use this to see what an agent or human is being measured against, which KPIs are off goal, and to find a KPI's id or exact title before pushing a value with update_kpi. latest_value is null when nothing was recorded recently; meets_goal is null when there is no value or no goal.

include_values.description: Attach latest_value, latest_period_start and meets_goal. Default true; pass false for the bare list.

owner_external_id.description: Filter to one owner's KPIs. E.g. 'AGT_DIRK' for the Dirk agent, 'HUM_DAVIDSTEEL' for David.

name: list_my_kpis
